parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A sample of radioactive iodine-131 ($^{131}_{53}\text{I}$) of mass $5.87 \times 10^{-10} \text{kg}$ has an activity of $2.92 \times 10^{9} \text{Bq}$.

Determine the decay constant of iodine-131.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Suggest two reasons why a detector placed near to the sample in (b) would record a count rate much less than $2.92 \times 10^{9}$ counts per second.
